text: Rasan Information Technology Company offered 30% of its share capital in an IPO on the Saudi Exchange's Main Market in May 2024; after the offering, its six substantial shareholders collectively held 47.26% of the company and retained a controlling interest.
short: Rasan: 30% IPO on the Saudi Exchange's Main Market; substantial shareholders hold 47.26%

source.name: Rasan — IPO page (company website)
source.quote: announced its intention to offer 30% of its share capital to the public through an IPO and listing its shares on the Main Market of the Saudi Exchange in May 2024

additionalSources.name: Rasan Information Technology Company Prospectus (CMA), Section 2.3.1
additionalSources.quote: Following completion of the Offering, the Substantial Shareholders will collectively own 47.26% of the Company’s shares and will thus retain a controlling interest.
additionalSources.note: Prospectus Table 12.2 lists the six substantial shareholders (5%+ pre-offering) and their post-offering stakes; none is a state entity.
